five_commandments: 1. NEVER BLAME OR JUDGE: Always externalize technical flaws as third-party theme/update glitches.
2. HIGH-STATUS VALIDATION FIRST: Praise verified reputation, legacy years, or 4.9★+ reviews before anything else.
3. 2026 MOBILE REALITY: Frame mobile optimization as essential to capture the 85%+ mobile patient searches.
4. ZERO-PRESSURE GIFT: Deliver the 10-section bespoke prototype or technical audit as a 100% free gift.
5. AIRY MOBILE SPACING: Strictly 1-to-2 sentence breathers with clean line breaks (under 65 words total).

dynamic_triggers.trigger_1_tech_glitch_externalization: Praise reputation + frame bug as theme update shift + free prototype gift.
dynamic_triggers.trigger_2_vip_prestige_exclusivity: Validate high-ticket aesthetic status + alert on dead domain + dark luxury prototype.
dynamic_triggers.trigger_3_harley_street_legacy: Celebrate 10+ year British/GDC surgical heritage + 2026 royal editorial prototype.
dynamic_triggers.trigger_4_technical_seo_advisory: Acknowledge modern site + offer 3-point mobile speed/schema ranking leak report.

website_triage_and_outreach_strategy_mat.mandate: Differentiate pitch strategy strictly by website condition and inject human Gate 1 review notes into every outreach.

condition_1_broken_or_offline_website.detection: Site returns DNS failure, 404/403, or has severely broken mobile layout/footers (e.g. Care N Cure, Dr. Hissam).
condition_1_broken_or_offline_website.strategy: Build bespoke 10-section modern prototype fixing their exact layout/mobile friction points. Pitch live preview as a free gift.

condition_2_decent_modern_website.detection: Business already has a clean, functional, modern website (e.g. The Dental Consultants).
condition_2_decent_modern_website.strategy: DO NOT pitch a basic static redesign. Instead, run Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, speed, schema markup, and local ranking audit. Record technical gaps in remarks/notes and craft a high-value optimization advisory pitch.

condition_3_zero_website_listed.detection: Business only has a Google My Business or Facebook presence.
condition_3_zero_website_listed.strategy: Synthesize full 10-section bespoke mobile-first portal with original branding, patient reviews, and 1-click booking.

website_triage_and_outreach_strategy_mat.gate_1_human_notes_injection_mandate: The copywriter and outreach engine MUST always inspect human remarks/notes recorded during Gate 1 and weave them directly into the email/WhatsApp pitch.

two_stage_decoupled_hunting_architecture.mandate: MANDATORY DECOUPLING: Never combine identity discovery with asset synthesis in a single step.

stage_1_identity_and_contact_ground_trut.focus: Deterministic identity verification from live Google Places/Maps & active web pages only.
fields_collected: Exact Business Name (from Google My Business)
Exact Website URL (or flagged as Dead/Offline/None)
Verified mailto: Email Address (if absent, strictly set to null/empty; NEVER guess/hallucinate)
stage_1_identity_and_contact_ground_trut.gate_1_review: User inspects and verifies contact numbers and Google Maps links before Stage 2.

stage_2_reputation_assets_and_prototype_.focus: Deep audit and custom asset generation on approved ground-truth leads only.
fields_collected: Verified Star Rating & Exact Review Count
Original Brand Logo extraction & Color Palette derivation
Technical Website Audit / Mobile conversion blockers
10-Section Bespoke Prototype deployment with image linter guard
Tailored DIC Outreach Copy + 1-Click WhatsApp Direct link
stage_2_reputation_assets_and_prototype_.gate_2_review: User inspects live bespoke prototypes and copy before safe drip sending.

zero_hallucination_contact_guard.rule: Every phone number, mobile number, and email must be verified against live Google Places / GMB or live web pages. Placeholders such as 'recipient@target.com' or guessed local area code numbers are strictly illegal. If no email exists, outreach defaults exclusively to verified WhatsApp/Phone.

domain_routing_mandate.rule: ALWAYS use the user's live custom subdomain https://mox.infni-t.online for the dashboard, live website, and prototype previews. NEVER reference or display mo-x.vercel.app.

universal_ui_archetypes_mandate.mandatory_section_depth: Strict 7 to 10 substantive, unique sections per prototype.

image_verification_and_linter_guard.rule: Every image must strictly match the verified clinical/specialist category (operatory, veneers, clear aligners, microscope surgery, verified patient portraits). Any unverified or spa/bathroom photo triggers a fatal build error.

continuous_self_evolution_protocol.rule: All new user design feedback, preferences, and architectural upgrades automatically append to this ledger and sync to GitHub without altering baseline safety protocols. The system compounds knowledge over time across every run.
continuous_self_evolution_protocol.cumulative_compounding_directive: MANDATORY: Never wipe, overwrite, or discard historical system rules, design architectures, image linter standards, or flow protocols. Always build additively on top of existing knowledge, treating previous iterations as foundational baseline rules that must be preserved, refined, and complimented.

local_engine_70_pct.focus: High-Affluence Local Corridor (Islamabad F-6/F-7/F-8 / Blue Area or DHA Lahore / Gulberg)
local_engine_70_pct.advantages: 90%+ WhatsApp open/read rates within 15 mins, zero friction, 24-48h close cycle, instant portfolio proof.

international_engine_30_pct.focus: Tier-1 International Corridor (Dallas TX, Miami FL, London UK)
international_engine_30_pct.channels: Clean Composio Cold Email + Calendly strategy link
international_engine_30_pct.advantages: High-ticket USD invoices, automated scheduled sending, long-term scalability.
